diagnosis.control_plane: Python submitted one TaskVine object at a time while declaring 9437184 source URLs and binding 15335424 task inputs. The manager retained the million-task table and synchronously generated transaction/runtime writes.
diagnosis.parallelism: TaskVine's default attempt-schedule-depth is 100. The first scheduling pass lazily installed the function library on exactly 100 of 128 connected workers; deterministic refill left 28 workers idle and capped activity at 1600 of 2048 cores.

reason_not_accepted: The run was stopped after proving that the 1600-core ceiling would fail the required 1844-core central-window gate. No summary.json or PASS artifact was produced.
